stage0027_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$聖天使学園$$, $$シュレード$$'s Room ～

stage0027_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$シュレード$$
「...A visitor at this hour is rare...」

stage0027_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Heh... a window visitor, at this late hour...
　Are you an angel? Or perhaps a reaper...」

stage0027_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Either is fine.
　If you liked my piano, that's enough for me.」

stage0027_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
???
「Won't you let me hear more?
　The melody of your soul.」

stage0027_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Then let me play my finest, unfinished as it is.」

stage0027_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$シュレード$$
「The first movement of the ultimate melody I seek.」

stage0027_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
???
「I do hope...
　that the world's filled with lovely sound...」

stage0027_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$葵$$
「...Glad the talks between the transferees
　and the Earth Federation worked out.」

stage0027_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Since those who got transported were limited
　to the area around that school called
　$$聖天使学園$$, and a few other spots.」

stage0027_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「The small number of transferees made it
　easy to reach agreement. That's likely the
　biggest factor behind this smooth reception.」

stage0027_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「It was a small mercy that the transferred area
　was mostly cleared land, marked for development.」

stage0027_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Rumor is the developers are thrilled
　the construction wrapped up in an instant.」

stage0027_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$カレン$$
「Tough for those caught in the $$時空震動$$,
　but it all worked out in the end.」

stage0027_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I hear that area's being annexed into
　Japan's administration as $$アクエリア市$$.」

stage0027_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Still, it's a surprise that Holy Angel
　Academy's Chairwoman became $$アクエリア市$$'s rep.」

stage0027_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah.
　She sure looks like a girl... a middle schooler.」

stage0027_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「They say Chairwoman $$クレア$$'s age is undisclosed.」

stage0027_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Well, age doesn't matter.
　If she sealed the deal with the federal
　government, she must be capable.」

stage0027_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Not just a figurehead. A real leader.」

stage0027_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$オードリー$$
「No...
　I was just thinking that Chairwoman $$クレア$$
　sounds like someone worth admiring...」

stage0027_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah.
　I think anyone standing over others
　should be just like that too.」

stage0027_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Judging by how those pursuing $$オードリー$$ spoke,
　she seems to be someone of high standing...
　Is she comparing herself to that Chairwoman...?）

stage0027_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$デュオ$$
「So, they say a big-name guest is coming to
　the ceremony for $$アクエリア市$$'s founding,
　starting tomorrow. Right, $$アルト$$?」

stage0027_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$n
「What's wrong, $$アルト$$...
　Why are you so rattled?」

stage0027_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Well, $n, you see.
　Thanks to that big-name guest, $$アルト$$'s heart
　is all a-flutter with excitement.」

stage0027_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$n
「I don't get it, not one bit...」

stage0027_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アルト$$
「Fine, forget it!
　I'm going to maintain my unit!」

stage0027_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$オードリー$$
「It seems he's hiding something.」

stage0027_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$n
「...Now that I think about it, he...
　tried to dig into my private life
　under the Volunteer Club's name...」

stage0027_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$宗介$$
「I understand your thinking, $n.
　I will cooperate as a club member.」

stage0027_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$n
「$$バナージ$$, $$オードリー$$.
　I'm having you two help out too.」

stage0027_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Are we going to dig into that person's secrets?」

stage0027_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But we're... not even Volunteer Club members...」

stage0027_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Might as well go for it, $$バナージ$$.
　This is good practice too.」

stage0027_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You mean it's needed to become a good pilot?」

stage0027_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（No, that's not it.
　$$オードリー$$ looks worn down, so
　take her out to clear her head.）

stage0027_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$葵$$
「Do your best, both $$バナージ$$ and $$オードリー$$.」

stage0027_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$カレン$$
「Since we were $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ members, we already
　know the answer, so we'll just relax and
　enjoy the ceremony.」

stage0027_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$n
「Then it's settled. I'll secure personnel.
　$$宗介$$, contact Chidori.」

stage0027_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$n
「I'll go call $$シンジ$$ and $$レイ#333$$ too.
　The strategy meeting is early tomorrow.」

stage0027_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$宗介$$
「This operation is hereby named Code Princess.
　I expect everyone's best effort.」

stage0027_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$アンディ$$
「So, $$アマタ$$...
　Getting used to school life yet?」

stage0027_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Even if you ask that, it's only been
　a week since I enrolled...」

stage0027_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「If you say that, it's been a week since
　we got sent to this world too.」

stage0027_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$モロイ$$
「$$アンディ$$'s right.
　Both you and we must adapt to this new environment.」

stage0027_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Hang in there, $$アマタ$$.
　Your beloved $$ミコノ$$'s right there with you.」

stage0027_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$モロイ$$
「No use hiding it.
　It's all over school that you two hijacked
　Aquaria, no, Aquarion, as a couple.」

stage0027_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Th-that was a situation I didn't get either...」

stage0027_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$モロイ$$
「But for us, it was a blessing in disguise.
　Thanks to that, we found a new Element
　user in you.」

stage0027_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アマタ$$
（The power that makes me float when my heart races
　was an Element ability.）

stage0027_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Well, since $$アマタ$$'s an Element, it's only
　natural he'd enroll here, but as for
　$$ミコノ$$, though...」

stage0027_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Stop, $$アンディ$$.
　True, we detected no Element ability in her,
　but we can't turn away someone from our world.」

stage0027_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Treating her as a student until things
　settle down is only natural.」

stage0027_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Just so you know, I'm all for $$ミコノ$$ enrolling.
　More cute girls around is always welcome.」

stage0027_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$モロイ$$
「That's enough of that.
　He's glaring at you.」

stage0027_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$アマタ$$
（That $$カイエン$$ guy...
　he's $$ミコノ$$'s older brother, huh...）

stage0027_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$アマタ$$
（But why's he so hard on $$ミコノ$$,
　even though he's her brother...）

stage0027_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Since you're an Element,
　I have no objection to your enrollment...」

stage0027_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$カイエン$$
「But I have no intention of acknowledging
　someone who was an amateur until recently.」

stage0027_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$カイエン$$
「And I'll say this too.
　If you ever drag $$ミコノ$$ into battle again,
　I will not forgive you...」

stage0027_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$カイエン$$
「She can't do anything out there.
　Don't ever send someone like that to war.」

stage0027_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Your boyfriend's getting hassled by your brother.」

stage0027_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Hey, hey, $$ミコノ$$!
　What kind of brother was $$カイエン$$ at home?」

stage0027_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「...$$カイエン$$ was recognized as an Element
　when I was little, and he left home...」

stage0027_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Speaking of the Suzushiro family,
　they've had Element users for generations.」

stage0027_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I wasn't trying to be snide or anything...」

stage0027_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Don't let it bother you.
　$$ゼシカ$$ didn't mean any harm by it.」

stage0027_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's true I have no Element ability, after all...」

stage0027_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Don't worry about that, don't worry!
　More importantly, now that we're enrolled,
　we've gotta enjoy school life!」

stage0027_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「For starters, introduce me to $$カイエン$$...」

stage0027_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$サザンカ$$, don't get carried away!
　It's already appalling enough that boys
　are even in this room with us...!」

stage0027_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「...But why does this school keep boys
　and girls apart so strictly...?」

stage0027_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$モロイ$$
「I don't really know the reason,
　but that's just the policy.」

stage0027_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Right now, to calm the chaos after the
　transfer, at least classes are coed.」

stage0027_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Even so, the boys' seats and girls' seats
　are completely separated...」

stage0027_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$アンディ$$
「But, $$アマタ$$!
　Your arrival is about to change all that!」

stage0027_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Your arrival broke the seal on the forbidden
　male-female mecha combination!」

stage0027_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That's right!
　And boy-girl combination brings
　pleasure beyond imagining!」

stage0027_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$アンディ$$
「When I heard that, I made up my mind!
　I'll combine with my destined match!」

stage0027_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$モロイ$$
「So, who is this destined match of yours?」

stage0027_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That's what I'm about to find out!
　By crossing that Berlin Wall!」

stage0027_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アマタ$$
「The Berlin Wall... the one splitting
　the boys' and girls' dorms...?」

stage0027_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ドナール$$
「That's enough, you two!
　Cut the chatter and sit down now!」

stage0027_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Tomorrow there will be a ceremony
　marking this world's welcome of us」

stage0027_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Many outsiders will be visiting
　this academy, so never act
　frivolous or careless around them」

stage0027_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「A question, instructor!
　Outsiders means men are coming, too, right?」

stage0027_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$アンディ$$
（What are you talking about, $$アマタ$$!
　This is our big chance!）

stage0027_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$アンディ$$
（Sure, I want to meet outside girls
　too, but during the ceremony we
　can freely mingle with our own）

stage0027_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$アンディ$$
（Here I'll find my destined match...!
　It's your chance to get closer
　to your beloved $$ミコノ$$ too!）

stage0027_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「That's the ability where he
　floats when he gets excited...」

stage0027_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「He must be thinking something
　indecent, that one!」

stage0027_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Hmm...
　We'll need that gear the
　Chairwoman prepared after all...」

stage0027_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text: ～ $$アクエリア市$$ Founding Ceremony, Venue ～

stage0027_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$赤木$$
「So this is the famous
　$$聖天使学園$$...!」

stage0027_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$マオ$$
「As expected of a place from
　another world, it's got atmosphere」

stage0027_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$青山$$
「Looks like there's still time
　before the famous Chairwoman's speech」

stage0027_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$クルツ$$
「It's one of today's main events.
　That's what I came here for」

stage0027_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$いぶき$$
「You guys... going after even
　a kid that small now?」

stage0027_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$青山$$
「Hold on, $$いぶき$$.
　Isn't 'prey on' a bit much?」

stage0027_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah, yeah.
　We just like admiring cute
　little things」

stage0027_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Don't tell me... you two are
　into little girls...」

stage0027_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Calm down, $$いぶき$$.
　The Chairwoman's an age-unknown
　mystery girl, after all」

stage0027_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$マオ$$
「Lt. Col. Katsuragi!
　That's a bit of a stretch, ma'am!」

stage0027_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$いぶき$$
「No good, these two...
　they're already smashed...」

stage0027_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$赤木$$
「Whoa! What's with all
　these empty cans!?」

stage0027_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$青山$$
「A beauty running on beer as
　fuel, huh. Not bad, but I'll pass」

stage0027_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$クルツ$$
「$$赤木$$, come to think of it,
　what happened to $$シンジ$$?」

stage0027_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$赤木$$
「Those two are off doing
　Volunteer Club activities」

stage0027_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$マオ$$
「That's great!
　Picking up litter or something～?」

stage0027_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Then let's have them clean
　up these empty cans!」

stage0027_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Please clean up after
　yourselves at least!」

stage0027_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even a prison wall might not
　be this tall...」

stage0027_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「This is called the Berlin Wall.
　It separates the boys' and
　girls' dorms at this academy」

stage0027_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$アルト$$
「To have something like this...
　this school's strict about
　discipline, huh...」

stage0027_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「You... are you a student
　at this academy, maybe?」

stage0027_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$サザンカ$$
（A gorgeous duo...!
　The one with glasses must be
　pursuing the tsundere type...）

stage0027_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「N-nothing's wrong!
　Nothing at all!」

stage0027_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「No way that's nothing...
　That was a visible electrical
　discharge just now」

stage0027_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Did someone use something
　like a stun gun?」

stage0027_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ルカ$$
「No, $$正太郎$$.
　Seems to be this bracelet
　she's wearing」

stage0027_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$サザンカ$$
（N-no way...! A gorgeous boy
　in shorts, and a boy who
　seems submissive but's really pushy...!）

stage0027_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「She's iffy in more ways
　than one, isn't she...」

stage0027_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$クレア$$
「It monitors body temp, heart rate,
　and sweat, then shocks them
　past a set threshold...」

stage0027_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$学園長$$
「Chairwoman... what's the
　meaning of that device?」

stage0027_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$クレア$$
「This is essential to bring out
　the Elements' full power, while
　avoiding a tragedy like Aquarion's...」

stage0027_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$学園長$$
「But, Chairwoman...
　when did you prepare
　something like that?」

stage0027_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$クレア$$
「That was entrusted to
　me, by him」

stage0027_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$学園長$$
「What!
　That person's here as well...!?」

stage0027_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
Banagher
「...$$バナージ・リンクス$$ here.
　No suspicious behavior from
　$$アルト$$ so far」

stage0027_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Roger, $$バナージ$$.
　But don't you dare
　look away from him」

stage0027_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Continue the mission.
　Also, die and no one'll
　come for your corpse」

stage0027_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What was that last line...?」

stage0027_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Bear all responsibility yourself...
　It means to face the mission
　with that much resolve」

stage0027_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Amazing, $$オードリー$$.
　You even know things like that」

stage0027_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Come on, that's enough, $$バナージ$$.
　Others are tailing $$アルト$$ too,
　so let's enjoy the ceremony」

stage0027_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Yeah! I heard some big-name
　artist is coming too!」

stage0027_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「A singer big on $$ＡＤＷ$$, they say.
　And a stunning beauty and cutie
　too, so it's gotta be those two!」

stage0027_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$アンディ$$
「...What's going on!?
　All the holes we dug to sneak
　under the Wall are filled in!」

stage0027_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「No way...!
　After all that work
　digging them!」

stage0027_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Damn it! Our plan to sneak into
　the girls' dorm amid the chaos
　is completely shot!」

stage0027_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But with your power to find
　weak spots, $$アンディ$$, can't you
　just dig again right away...?」

stage0027_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That's the problem!
　Where they filled the holes,
　there's not one weak spot left!」

stage0027_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I knew it...
　Those suspicious holes were made
　with Element powers after all」

stage0027_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I'm $$ＭＩＸ$$, the student council chief.
　I plugged every hole you dug
　with my Space Fill power」

stage0027_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「You! What do you think our holes are!?
　Me and $$アマタ$$, the Digging Brothers,
　risked our lives to dig those!」

stage0027_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Silence!
　Trying to cross the Berlin Wall
　is a total violation of the rules!」

stage0027_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$アンディ$$
（Never noticed watching from afar
　in class... she looks tough,
　but cute...! And more than that...）

stage0027_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「That's what you get for
　thinking something lewd!」

stage0027_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$アルト$$
「No, my fault.
　Are you hurt?」

stage0027_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah, that's right!
　I'm a man!」

stage0027_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're the one who ran into me!」

stage0027_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, $$アルト$$!
　I'm the class rep, and I won't allow
　fighting in a place like this!」

stage0027_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I see...
　So you were touring the ceremony with
　$$宗介$$?」

stage0027_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Wait! What's with you, $$ミシェル$$!
　That creepy grin!」

stage0027_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sousuke's not the only one here,
　$n and Miss $$スズネ$$ are here too,
　and so are $$シンジ$$ and $$レイ#333$$!」

stage0027_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$アルト$$
「What's with that group...
　Some Volunteer Club thing?」

stage0027_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$n
「There's a member acting shady,
　so I'm just looking into it.」

stage0027_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Oh my... coming from someone,
　can you really say that?」

stage0027_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$!
　And $$ランカ$$ too!」

stage0027_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ランカ$$
「Long time no see, $$アルト$$!」

stage0027_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$かなめ$$
「N-no way!
　$$シェリル・ノーム$$ and $$ランカ・リー$$!?」

stage0027_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$n
「You don't know, $$宗介$$?
　You said in your transfer greeting
　your favorite artist was $$シェリル・ノーム$$.」

stage0027_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sigh... your cluelessness
　gives me a headache every time...」

stage0027_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Listen!
　These two are the biggest stars
　in 《$$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$》!」

stage0027_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Wherever they go, there's song!
　Wherever they go, there's fans!
　Wherever they go, there's thrill and passion!」

stage0027_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Ouch, that hurts to hear.
　But once you hear my live show,
　I'll have you hooked for sure.」

stage0027_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$アルト$$
「...are you sure about this...?
　The live's about to start,
　and you're loafing around here...」

stage0027_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「You're as dense as ever, $$アルト$$.
　Saying that to the two who pushed
　themselves just to come see you.」

stage0027_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Sadly, time's up.
　People nearby are starting
　to notice the divas.」

stage0027_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$シェリル$$
「See you, $$アルト$$.
　Make sure you listen to my song.」

stage0027_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Now that you mention it, I've heard something.」

stage0027_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Behind the popular $$シェリル・ノーム$$ and $$ランカ・リー$$,
　there's said to be one man supporting them...」

stage0027_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「This guy...!
　You mean he's two-timing those two!?」

stage0027_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$アルト$$
「N-no, that's not true!
　That's just gossip rags stirring things up!」

stage0027_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$アルト$$
「W-what's your problem!?
　Popping out of nowhere...」

stage0027_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Forget about me!
　But to think two beauties like that
　fell for you!」

stage0027_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$アンディ$$
「$$アマタ$$! Say something too!
　Like 'I'm jealous' or 'what a waste'
　or 'share some with me!'」

stage0027_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$n
「Could it be... you're the one
　who rode that robot, Aquarion, the other day?」

stage0027_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$アマタ$$
「S-sorry...!
　I just remembered somewhere I need to be!」

stage0027_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What's wrong, well...
　I saw you walking alone, $$ミコノ$$...」

stage0027_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I wonder... if I even belong
　at this academy...」

stage0027_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I don't have any power like
　$$カイエン$$ or you, $$アマタ$$...」

stage0027_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Power doesn't matter.
　To me, you're...!」

stage0027_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Heh... you're a strange one, $$アマタ$$...」

stage0027_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's only been a little while
　since we met, but it feels like
　so much longer's passed. Strange...」

stage0027_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I don't think it's strange.
　Meeting you, $$ミコノ$$,
　felt like fate to me...!」

stage0027_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$アマタ$$
「W-what am I even saying...?
　Sorry, forget that! Please, forget it!」

stage0027_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I don't want to forget it.」

stage0027_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Ow, ow...
　Thanks to that shock, I didn't float up...」

stage0027_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Shut it.
　I've got no business with you.」

stage0027_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What are you...?
　You don't have a scent...」

stage0027_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You! Get away from $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0027_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Get lost, you scentless freak!
　This lousy woman's mine!」

stage0027_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$ is... not yours...!
　I won't hand her over to you!」

stage0027_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Anyone who gets in my way, I'll kill.」

stage0027_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Getting in my way, huh...
　Then I'll kill you first!」

stage0027_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$シュレード$$
「If you think you can play me.」

stage0027_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What!?
　He's in pain from the sound of a violin!」

stage0027_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$シュレード$$
「This melody touches his subconscious
　directly, and plays out pain...」

stage0027_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Damn iiiit!!
　I won't forget your scent!!」

stage0027_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Heh... even his retreat
　is like a wild beast's.」

stage0027_03:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$シュレード$$
「That's right.
　That man was likely the one piloting
　the humanoid Abductor the other day.」

stage0027_03:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Are you all right, $$ミコノ$$?
　If you'd gotten hurt, my best friend
　wouldn't have stayed quiet about it.」

stage0027_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Are you all right, $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0027_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$アマタ・ソラ$$!
　You were right beside $$ミコノ$$,
　and you let the intruder do as he pleased!?」

stage0027_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$シュレード$$
「That's enough now, best friend.
　I intercepted the intruder myself.」

stage0027_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Besides, his... $$アマタ$$'s tone is precious.
　Honest, and one of a kind.」

stage0027_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Don't make such a scary face.
　$$アマタ$$ and I both tried to protect your sister.」

stage0027_03:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$シュレード$$... are you feeling all right?」

stage0027_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Worried about me, best friend?」

stage0027_03:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$カイエン$$
「It's just rare seeing you
　out of your room at all...!」

stage0027_03:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$シュレード$$
「There's been one exciting thing after another lately.
　And today, a lovely song drifted in from outside.」

stage0027_03:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Same as ever, talking nonsense...!」

stage0027_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$アマタ$$
（That $$シュレード$$ guy...
　Is something wrong with his health...?）

stage0027_03:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$シュレード$$
「This faint discord... a dimensional gate is opening.」

stage0027_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Are they... are the Abductors coming!?」

stage0027_03:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$, let's get to safety!」

stage0027_03:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I... I need to apologize... to him...」

stage0027_03:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Apologize? To him...?
　What do you mean, $$ミコノ$$!?」

stage0027_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I don't know...
　But somehow, when he caught me, I was scared...」

stage0027_03:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「But that hot breath of his...
　Somehow, it felt... nostalgic...」

stage0027_03:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Was that from the fight just now...!」

stage0027_03:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Yes! Alright!
　Now I won't even need to dig a hole!
　I can march right into the girls' dorm!」

stage0027_03:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'm doing it anyway, Big Bang!」

stage0027_03:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$不動$$
「Silence!
　Now that the wall dividing men and women
　is destroyed, I will declare this to you all!」

stage0027_03:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$不動$$
「From now on, romance is forbidden!!」

stage0027_03:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$イズモ$$
「...The Mechanical Angel...
　So its parameters shift along with its form...」

stage0027_03:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
???
「Heh heh... so that is indeed the one
　standing in the way of Altair's wish...」

stage0027_03:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's been a while, $$イズモ$$.
　$$ジン$$'s grown up so well, hasn't he?」

stage0027_03:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$イズモ$$
「...Seems you met $$ジン$$ before he sortied.
　When did you even wake up, anyway?」

stage0027_03:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I was given a kiss to wake me.
　An invitation to the edge of myth,
　and the Mechanical Angel's revival...」

stage0027_03:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes...
　That Vega is a world out of phase
　with the Vega we know...」

stage0027_03:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But Vega is still Vega...
　In fact, for Altair, that very Vega
　should prove to be our salvation.」

stage0027_03:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$イズモ$$
「The $$時空震動$$'s effect on Altair was smaller
　than expected. Just a different gate destination.」

stage0027_03:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$イズモ$$
「So we continue searching Vega
　for the $$レア・イグラー$$, same as before.」

stage0027_03:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「As expected of Altair's Commander, $$イズモ$$...
　A sound decision.」

stage0027_03:r_ae4d9169d6ff43a4.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And the invitation to the edge of myth
　must have awakened Vega's $$レア・イグラー$$.」

stage0027_03:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$カグラ$$ is the proof of that.
　He's the chosen one who ran off
　toward a new frontier of love...」

stage0027_03:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$イズモ$$
「A new frontier of love...?
　So that's the reason for $$カグラ$$'s reckless sortie...」

stage0027_03:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Invited to the edge of myth, the Mechanical Angel
　opened a forbidden door... $$カグラ$$ was drawn
　to the $$レア・イグラー$$ within it.」

stage0027_03:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Aren't you curious about the $$レア・イグラー$$
　he pursues so relentlessly?」

stage0027_03:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「One who commands the Mechanical Angel,
　one who crosses the wall of dimensions...
　Such a $$レア・イグラー$$ could become our Altair's true Eve.」

stage0027_03:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「...An investigation may indeed be needed...」

stage0027_03:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Heh heh... and there's more meaning to this Vega
　now than just producing a $$レア・イグラー$$...）

stage0027_03:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Twelve thousand years...
　no, the endpoint of a bond far older than that...
　now, let the curtain rise on the final myth...）

stage0027_03:r_263097ee015a04ab.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Still, that was reckless of him.」

stage0027_03:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Dragging those guys in by force was the plan,
　but pulling in Mr. Singularity too? That's overkill...」

stage0027_03:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's why a rift forms,
　and trans-dimensional life forms come pouring in.」

stage0027_03:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「The dimensional boundary's correction will
　likely take some amount of time.」

stage0027_03:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So the clock's hands turned back a bit, huh...
　Sigh...」

stage0027_03:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If the needles we drove into the promising ones
　come loose, what are you gonna do about it?」

stage0027_03:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「That point should be no problem.
　The seal placed on the $$烙印$$-bearers is working
　exactly as expected.」

stage0027_03:r_f2655371e3ef7b59.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well... fine, I guess...
　Without accidents like that,
　I'd die of boredom myself...」

stage0027_03:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Sure am...
　My only fun is burning my throat and stomach
　with this water of life.」

stage0027_03:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't make that face, honey.
　You'll ruin that pretty face of yours.」

stage0027_03:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well... guess that lord's just that desperate too...
　Let's just make sure we don't slip up,
　and get to work ourselves...」

stage0027_03:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Found myself a toy that might be fun, too...」

stage0027_03:r_9b8d839e83da7879.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Are you the one going out?」

stage0027_03:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Nah... I'm just a bystander.
　I'll leave the fieldwork to my capable vice-commander.」

stage0027_03:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Understood.
　Even if it means staking the honor of 'G'.」

stage0027_03:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So uptight...
　You could at least call yourself Geminis here...」

stage0027_03:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh my...?
　Didn't anyone tell you about me?
　I'm $$ＡＧ$$, an agent of $$ＤＥＭ$$.」

stage0027_03:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$桂$$
「N-no... I did hear about you, but...」

stage0027_03:r_c5f074a439f6c890.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then why do you keep avoiding me, Master $$桂$$?」

stage0027_03:r_8b22d4b99ca35b84.text:
$$桂$$
「That way of talking creeps me out!」

stage0027_03:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Aww!
　But I'm a robot, so it's basic manners
　to address everyone with 'Master'.」

stage0027_03:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$桂$$
「Quit talking all cutesy on purpose!
　And you don't need 'Master' for me!」

stage0027_03:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, $$桂$$... from now on, you're the only
　one I'll drop the honorific for.」

stage0027_03:r_d3ea963a3518a978.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just kidding, a dimensional joke.
　Keep this up and Master $$モーム$$, glaring
　over there, might really get angry.」

stage0027_03:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For my own part, I'd like us robots
　to get along with each other.」

stage0027_03:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$桂$$
「Fair enough.
　Then I'll leave $$モーム$$ in your hands.」

stage0027_03:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, leave it to me.
　I'll shape Mome up into championship
　material within three years.」

stage0027_03:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Jokes aside,
　today's a sale to mark Master $$ランカ・リー$$'s live!
　Let's get to it... business, business!」
